source_refs.note: Exercise 3.7, Question 1 (book p. 121); answers printed in the key (book p. 302) under the heading 'Exercise 3.8'.

blocks.prompt: 1. Find the moment of inertia \(I\) of a uniform rectangular plate \(ABCD\) about the edge \(AD\) when \(AD = 3\), \(AB = 8\), \(BC = 3\), \(CD = 8\) and the mass per unit area is 4.
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: ek continuous plate ki moment of inertia ek edge ke gird, yani strip method wala sawal.
Diya kya hai? Plate 8 by 3 hai, aur har unit area ka mass 4 hai; axis edge \(AD\) hai jis ki lambai 3 hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(AD\) ke gird \(I\).
Plan: \(AD\) ke parallel patli strips lenge jo \(AD\) se \(x\) faasle par hon; \(\delta m = 4 \times 3\,\delta x\), \(\delta I = x^{2}\,\delta m\), aur \(x = 0\) se \(x = 8\) tak integrate.
steps:
Diya gaya: rectangle \(ABCD\), \(AB = CD = 8\), \(AD = BC = 3\); fi unit area mass \(= 4\).
Maloom karna: edge \(AD\) ke gird \(I\).
Tareeqa: \(A\) ko origin, \(AB\) ko \(x\)-axis aur \(AD\) (jo axis hai) ko \(y\)-axis maan lein. Plate ko \(AD\) ke parallel patli strips mein kaatein: aisi strip ka har point \(AD\) se ek hi faasle \(x\) par hota hai, is liye us ki moment of inertia seedhi \(x^{2}\,\delta m\) hai.

Strip ka mass
\(AD\) se \(x\) faasle wali strip ki lambai 3 aur chaurai \(\delta x\) hai.
\[\delta m = 4 \times (3\,\delta x) = 12\,\delta x\]
Kyun: mass = (fi unit area mass) \(\times\) (strip ka area), aur area = lambai \(\times\) chaurai = \(3\,\delta x\).

Strip ki moment of inertia
\[\delta I = x^{2}\,\delta m = 12x^{2}\,\delta x\]
Kyun: poori strip \(AD\) se \(x\) faasle par hai, is liye woh \(x\) faasle par rakhe ek particle ki tarah hai: \(mr^{2}\) jahan \(r = x\).
Dhyan dein: agar strips \(AD\) par perpendicular le lete to har strip ke points alag faaslon par hote aur kaam mushkil ho jata.

Saari strips jama karein
\[I = \int_{0}^{8} 12x^{2}\,dx\]
\[= 12\left[\dfrac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{8} = 4\big[x^{3}\big]_{0}^{8}\]
\[= 4(512 - 0) = 2048\]
Kyun: strips \(AD\) (\(x = 0\)) se shuru ho kar saamne wali side \(BC\) (\(x = 8\)) tak jati hain, is liye limits 0 aur 8 hain. \(8^{3} = 512\).
Dhyan dein: limits 0 se 3 le lena ghalat hai; 3 to axis \(AD\) ki apni lambai hai, jab ke faasla \(x\) 0 se 8 tak jata hai.

Tasdeeq
Kul mass \(M = 4 \times (8 \times 3) = 96\). Edge ke gird plate bilkul ek rod ki tarah hai jo apne end ke gird ghoom rahi ho (chaurai se farq nahin parta), is liye \(I = \frac{1}{3}ML^{2}\) jahan \(L = 8\):
\[\dfrac{1}{3}(96)(64) = 2048\;\checkmark\]
Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya.
blocks.final_answer: \(I = 2048\) units (mass ki unit \(\times\) lambai ki unit\(^2\)).

blocks.text: Exercise 3.7 ke jawab key mein "Exercise 3.8" ke heading ke neeche chhape hain, aur numbering gadbad hai: "1." mein Q1 aur Q2 dono hain (\(I = 2048\) aur \(I = \frac{1}{6}Mh^{2}\)), "2.(a)-(c)" Q3 hai, "(d)", "(e)" Q4 hain, "3." Q6 hai, "4." teen dafa chhapa hai (Q7, Q12, Q13), aur Q8-Q11 "(d)", bina label, "(e)", "(f)" ki shakal mein hain. Q1 ke jawab mein "2048 units units" bhi chhapa hai. Yahan values khud sahi hain.
